f3_program: collection("jim.model_cars", "model_car", "jim", source("Jim collects model cars"))
observe(at("jim.model_cars.count", "current"), 301, "count", source("he has 301 models total"))
multiple("jim.model_cars.buick.count", "jim.model_cars.ford.count", 4, source("4 times as many Buicks as Fords"))
offset("jim.model_cars.ford.count", scale("jim.model_cars.chevy.count", 2), 3, "count", source("3 more than twice the number of Fords than Chevys"))
query("value", "jim.model_cars.buick.count")
assumptions: The comparative clause is interpreted as the Ford count being three more than twice the Chevy count.

f3_program: collection("national_park.bears", "bear", "national_park", source("bears in a national park"))
multiple("national_park.bears.black.count", "national_park.bears.white.count", 2, source("twice as many black bears as white bears"))
offset("national_park.bears.brown.count", "national_park.bears.black.count", 40, "count", source("40 more brown bears than black bears"))
observe(at("national_park.bears.black.count", "current"), 60, "count", source("the number of black bears in the park is 60"))
query("sum", "national_park.bears", "current")
assumptions: The named color groups constitute the bear population requested by the question.

f3_program: observe(at("marie.cash_register.cost", "current"), 1040, "currency", source("cash register for her bakery that costs $1040"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.bread.sold.count", "per_day"), 40, "count", source("Every day Marie sells 40 loaves of bread"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.bread.unit_price", "current"), 2, "currency", source("40 loaves of bread for $2 each"))

product_relation(at("marie.bakery.bread.sales_revenue", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.bread.sold.count", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.bread.unit_price", "current"), source("Every day Marie sells 40 loaves of bread for $2 each"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.cake.sold.count", "per_day"), 6, "count", source("6 cakes for $12 each"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.cake.unit_price", "current"), 12, "currency", source("6 cakes for $12 each"))
product_relation(at("marie.bakery.cake.sales_revenue", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.cake.sold.count", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.cake.unit_price", "current"), source("6 cakes for $12 each"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.rent.cost", "per_day"), 20, "currency", source("$20 each day for rent"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.electricity.cost", "per_day"), 2, "currency", source("$2 each day for electricity"))
query("value", "marie.cash_register.payoff_duration.day_count")
collection("melanie.brownies", "brownie", "melanie", source("Melanie baked 10 batches of brownies"))
observe(at("melanie.brownie_batches.count", "initial"), 10, "count", source("10 batches of brownies"))
observe(at("melanie.brownies.per_batch.count", "initial"), 20, "count", source("20 brownies in each batch"))

product_relation("melanie.brownies.baked.count", at("melanie.brownie_batches.count", "initial"), at("melanie.brownies.per_batch.count", "initial"), source("10 batches of brownies, with 20 brownies in each batch"))
produce("bake", "melanie", at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), "melanie.brownies.baked.count", source("Melanie baked 10 batches of brownies"))

transfer("set_aside_for_bake_sale", "melanie", at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), at("bake_sale.brownies.count", "current"), fraction(at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), 3, 4), source("She set aside 3/4 of the brownies in each batch for a bake sale"))

transfer("put_in_container", "melanie", at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), at("container.brownies.count", "current"), fraction(at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), 3, 5), source("put 3/5 of the remaining in a container"))
remove("give_out", "melanie", at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), source("gave out the rest"))
query("value", event_field("give_out", "quantity"))
observe(at("autodesk.goodwill.ending", "2018"), 1620.2, "million_currency", cell("Goodwill, end of the year", "January 31, 2018"))
observe(at("autodesk.goodwill.ending", "2019"), 2450.8, "million_currency", cell("Goodwill, end of the year", "January 31, 2019"))
query("mean", at("autodesk.goodwill.ending", "2018"), at("autodesk.goodwill.ending", "2019"))
